edge.name: Music Assistant Edge (jrhubott)
edge.summary: upstream development code plus jrhubott's feature branches (fixes and features in progress)
edge.data_note: This app runs upstream's development branch and can migrate the database to a schema that stable releases cannot read. Copy data into it, never out of it.

stable.name: Music Assistant Stable (jrhubott)
stable.summary: the latest upstream stable release plus jrhubott's stable-based fixes
stable.source: upstream's `stable` branch (the latest release plus backports about to be released)
stable.data_note: This app runs upstream's stable branch. You can copy data into it from the official app or another app on the same stable version, but not from Edge: edge data can have a newer schema.
